column1: # Pre-push host table schema (OMN-17232).
# The shipped table contains only the neutral disabled row below.
# A deployment supplies its complete fifteen-column table through the private
# workspace repository. PREPUSH_PRIVATE_TABLE_REL is declared by the caller;
# ONEX_WORKSPACE_CONFIG_ROOT resolves its root, else the sibling of OMNI_HOME.
# Both identity and placement come from that table, with real values in every
# applicable column. There are no @private placeholders to hydrate.
# Git checkout roots are read at HEAD and refused on working-tree divergence.
# Without a private table no host is designated or probed. Set
# ONEX_WORKSPACE_CONFIG_ROOT to a root holding the caller's table to configure it.
# Columns (TAB separated; no tabs inside a field):
# label: stable row id and PREPUSH_HOST_OVERRIDE_<LABEL> key
# role: capacity (placement and identity) or identity (identity only)
# hostname: lowercase short hostname; ssh_target: bare SSH host, never user@host
# cores: nominal core count; uv_abs_path: absolute uv executable; uv_min_version: floor
# workroot: remote scratch root; slot_mode: queue, lockdir or none
# slots: concurrent lanes; slot 1 uses LOCK, subsequent slots use LOCK.<index>
# repos_denied: comma-separated repo names or -
# mode: authorizing, shadow or disabled; only authorizing rows confer identity
# heavy_local: allowed or prefer_remote; placement_tier: default or last_resort
# note: free text
#label
local
column15: Neutral default row; configure a private deployment table to enable hosts.
